mapper.sql: bst.transition_id as "transitionId", bst.definition_version as "definitionVersion", bst.business_type as "businessType", bst.from_status_code as "fromStatusCode", bst.to_status_code as "toStatusCode", bst.executor_role_code as "executorRoleCode", bst.opinion_required_yn as "opinionRequiredYn", bst.attachment_required_yn as "attachmentRequiredYn", bst.cancellable_yn as "cancellableYn", bst.change_reason as "changeReason", bst.updated_by as "updatedBy", bst.updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
select from business_status_transitions bst
order by bst.business_type, bst.definition_version, bst.from_status_code, bst.to_status_code, bst.executor_role_code limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into business_status_transitions (definition_version, business_type, from_status_code, to_status_code, executor_role_code, opinion_required_yn, attachment_required_yn, cancellable_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{definitionVersion}, #{businessType}, #{fromStatusCode}, #{toStatusCode}, #{executorRoleCode}, #{opinionRequiredYn}, #{attachmentRequiredYn}, #{cancellableYn}, #{changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (business_type, definition_version, from_status_code, to_status_code, executor_role_code) do update set opinion_required_yn = EXCLUDED.opinion_required_yn, attachment_required_yn = EXCLUDED.attachment_required_yn, cancellable_yn = EXCLUDED.cancellable_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason})
